agent_response.answer:
Based on the search results, I can provide specific information about sensor termination configuration:

## Sensor Termination Configuration

For Meridian sensors using RS-485 communication, termination should be configured as follows:

• **Install 120Ω termination resistors** between the A and B terminals at **both ends** of the RS-485 bus (Installation Guide)

• **Use built-in terminators when available**: Most Meridian sensors have a built-in switchable terminator with a DIP switch labeled "TERM" (Installation Guide)

• **Enable termination at bus ends only**: Set the "TERM" DIP switch to ON for the sensor at each end of the daisy-chain bus, and leave it OFF for all sensors in the middle of the chain (Installation Guide)

## Important Wiring Notes

• **Use daisy-chain topology**: Wire all sensors in a bus topology, connecting A-to-A, B-to-B, and GND-to-GND across all devices (Installation Guide)

• **Avoid star topology**: Do not use star wiring patterns as they cause signal reflections (Installation Guide)

• **Check connections**: Reversed A/B connections are the most common wiring mistake (Troubleshooting Guide)

**Sources:**
- Installation Guide
- Troubleshooting Guide

## Calibration Points by Sensor Type

**Temperature Sensors (MI-T100 / MI-T200):**
- **Low point**: 0.0°C (ice bath reference using crushed ice made from distilled water)
- **High point**: 100°C at sea level (boiling water bath, adjusted for altitude - e.g., 95.0°C at 1650m elevation) (Calibration Procedures)

**Humidity Sensor (MI-H300):**
- **Factory calibration**: Four points at 25°C using saturated salt solutions: 11.3% RH, 33.0% RH, 75.3% RH, and 97.3% RH (MI-H300 Datasheet)
- **Field calibration**: Two points using the MI-CAL-H kit:
  - **Low point**: 33.0% RH (MgCl₂ chamber)
  - **High point**: 75.3% RH (NaCl chamber) (Calibration Procedures)

**Pressure Sensor (MI-P400):**
- Uses a single-point offset calibration against a reference barometer with ±0.1 hPa accuracy
- For differential pressure: zero offset calibration with both ports open to the same ambient pressure (Calibration Procedures)

All sensors are factory calibrated with NIST-traceable reference standards before shipment, and field recalibration is recommended at regular intervals to maintain accuracy (Calibration Procedures).

- Calibration Procedures
